questions.prompt: Why does the suite test that a VIEWER cannot trigger an allocation run, and what would a fuller suite add?

keyPoints.text: Finance numbers are only trustworthy when bad data is stopped at the door.
keyPoints.quote: Financial systems are only as trustworthy as ingress validation.

keyPoints.text: Refusing non-positive amounts keeps broken vendor exports out of past reports.
keyPoints.quote: Rejecting invalid amounts catches malformed vendor exports before they contaminate historical reports.

keyPoints.text: Oversized payloads, broken dates and absent nested tags each deserve a boundary case.
keyPoints.quote: Boundary tests for max payload size, malformed date strings, and missing nested tags.

keyPoints.text: Contract tests should pin the 422 body and its error details.
keyPoints.quote: Contract tests for API responses (422 payload shape and error details).

keyPoints.text: The amount rule is exercised by the cost-schema validation test.

questions.prompt: Which parts of the allocation engine and the chargeback report run with no test at all, and what could go wrong there?

keyPoints.text: computeAllocationResults has no test for its over-100% guard or its rounding.
The summary's matchedRules counts active rules, not the rules that actually matched.
keyPoints.quote: the fact that `summary.matchedRules` is the count of active rules rather than matched ones

keyPoints.text: Line items that match no rule fall back to the project, untested.
keyPoints.quote: the project fallback for unmatched items

keyPoints.text: The chargeback report looks its run up by exact equality on the month.
A run can be created with a month start that was never normalised.

questions.prompt: How would you show that tenant scoping and run transitions stay safe beyond today's unit tests?

keyPoints.text: Shared repository helpers or static analysis could enforce tenant scoping project-wide.
keyPoints.quote: Static analysis or shared repository helper tests to enforce tenant scoping conventions project-wide.

keyPoints.text: The lab stubs the repository, engine and queue modules around the real run service.
keyPoints.quote: It loads the real `src/services/allocationRunService.ts` with the repository, engine and queue modules stubbed

keyPoints.text: Terminal and skipped-phase moves are refused with a real ValidationError carrying status 422.
keyPoints.quote: plus terminal and skipped-phase refusals with the real `ValidationError` (status 422)

keyPoints.text: The isolation check lives in its own cost-repository test file.
Vitest collects only the .test.ts files under tests, so the .mjs lab never runs with it.
